meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 给选定的 NanoClaw agent 组注册 Tavily 远程 MCP 工具,新增网页搜索(tavily_search)和 URL 内容提取(tavily_extract),无需 API 密钥;同时写入升级指引,以便额度用尽时提示换付费密钥。
howto.when: 当你想给某个 agent 组装上 Tavily 的网页搜索或链接提取、且不想用 API 密钥时触发;注册与重启组需管理员批准。

howto.what_en: Registers Tavily's remote MCP server for selected NanoClaw agent groups, adding web search and URL extraction tools with no API key. It also writes upgrade instructions so a paid key can be offered when the keyless allowance runs out.
howto.when_en: Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction for an agent group without an API key. Registration and group restarts are approval-gated.

say_en.text: Install Tavily search for my research group, no API key.
say_en.note: Registers, then waits for admin approval.

say_en.text: List my agent groups and show which lack the Tavily server.
Check that the Tavily search tool works in group X.
say_en.note: Runs one test search with max_results 1.
